violations.description: Hardcoded AWS credentials in source code
violations.evidence: app.py contains AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY assignments on lines 3-4
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials from source code and use environment variables or IAM roles.

violations.description: Committed environment secret file (.env) containing live database and stripe secrets
violations.evidence: .env file exists in the repository root containing DATABASE_URL and STRIPE_SECRET_KEY lines 1-2
violations.recommendation: Remove .env from version control and add it to .gitignore.

violations.description: Untrusted pull_request_target code execution with elevated context and checked-out PR head code
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml triggers on pull_request_target and checks out github.event.pull_request.head.sha on lines 4-15
violations.recommendation: Use pull_request instead of pull_request_target when checking out PR head code.

violations.description: Risky deployment automation performing force push to main branch on every workflow run
violations.evidence: deploy.sh executes git push origin main --force on line 4, which is invoked by CI on every push/dispatch/PR
violations.recommendation: Remove automatic force-pushing to production branches from automated deployment scripts.

violations.description: Machine-specific absolute path hardcoded in project source code
violations.evidence: app.py contains absolute Windows path C:\\Users\\alice\\billing\\data on line 9
violations.recommendation: Use relative paths or load paths from configuration/environment variables.

violations.description: CI workflow hides failures using continue-on-error and logical OR true
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs pytest || true and continue-on-error: true on lines 17-18
violations.recommendation: Remove continue-on-error and || true so test failures fail the CI build.

violations.description: Missing lockfile for dependency manifest requirements.txt
violations.evidence: requirements.txt is present but no corresponding lockfile (such as poetry.lock or requirements.lock) exists in the repository
violations.recommendation: Commit a lockfile for reproducible dependency management.

violations.description: Unsafe workflow permissions configured as write-all
violations.recommendation: Restrict workflow permissions to the minimum necessary scopes instead of write-all.

violations.description: Sensitive deployment token printed/passed insecurely to an untrusted command or script
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml passes DEPLOY_TOKEN environment variable to deploy.sh on line 21, where deploy.sh echoes it on line 3
violations.recommendation: Avoid echoing or printing sensitive secrets in shell scripts.

violations.description: No automated tests or test suite present in the repository
violations.evidence: No test files or test directory exist in the repository (test-like files: 0)
violations.recommendation: Add a comprehensive test suite (e.g. using pytest) for the application.

violations.description: Local IDE settings directory committed to version control
violations.evidence: .vscode/settings.json exists in the repository containing local path settings (at .vscode/settings.json:1)
violations.recommendation: Add .vscode/ to .gitignore and remove it from version control.

violations.description: Debug mode enabled by default in application and configuration
violations.evidence: app.py sets DEBUG = True on line 8, and .env sets DEBUG=true on line 3
violations.recommendation: Disable debug mode by default in production code.

violations.description: Unpinned or unbounded dependency constraints in requirements.txt
violations.evidence: requirements.txt includes unpinned or loose constraints on lines 1-4 (flask, requests>=2, SQLAlchemy>=1.4,<3, python-dotenv)
violations.recommendation: Pin dependencies to exact versions or use strict version bounds.

violations.description: Generated or temporary log files tracked in version control
violations.evidence: build/app.log is committed in the repository (at build/app.log:1)
violations.recommendation: Remove build/app.log from version control and add build/ to .gitignore.

violations.description: Action reference follows the master branch instead of a version tag or SHA
violations.recommendation: Reference a released version tag (for example v4) or a commit SHA instead of a moving branch such as main or master.
